avis.titre: Kills acne quickly and prevents future breakouts
avis.texte: Much clearer than I was before this! I used to use this in my 20s and it kept my acne under control. I had straight away from it because it was bleaching my clothes and sheets. . however I started breaking out really bad after having babies and decided to go back to my old faithful. So glad I did because I get compliments all the time at 42 that I look way younger. This is definitely my favorite part of the three system because I know after I put this on, I won't wake up with new breakouts and I can put make up on top of it and it will protect my skin from breakouts from the make up. It definitely controls my oil, although I have to be careful to not put it around my eyes too much. I also have to wear the proactive sunscreen on top of it if I go in the sun. There is nothing better than this formulation anything with less percentage of benzoyl peroxide is too weak and anything stronger is too strong. I love it. Now I am just really careful not to put it near my neck line if I'm wearing something I don't want to get bleached and I have white sheets.
